rows.quote: Grants %AbilityCharges% charges.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶说明仍明确赋予技能充能。

rows.quote: magic_resistance.base: [20,30,40]→[16,24,32]
rows.reason_zh: 基础减魔抗数值下调，各级仍大于零。

rows.quote: applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves
rows.reason_zh: 目标仍会减速，且移动越多，减速越强。

rows.quote: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍对选中的单个敌人施加减魔抗和减速。

rows.quote: allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit
rows.reason_zh: 引导冲击波的是独立灵体，灵魂形态本身无需光之守卫持续引导。

rows.quote: increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed
rows.reason_zh: 灵魂形态仍会提高 Bright Speed 提供的移动速度加成。

rows.quote: allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies
rows.reason_zh: 基础灵魂形态仍能让冲击波治疗友军，魔晶进一步提高治疗量。

rows.quote: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认范围内的敌人会被吸引，但没有说明它们会受到伤害。

rows.quote: applies a non-interrupting pull
rows.reason_zh: 说明明确指出牵引不会打断持续施法。

rows.quote: drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker
rows.reason_zh: 两版都描述敌人被吸向灵光，但材料不足以区分被迫走近和直接拉动，无法确认排除位移的判断。

rows.quote: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
rows.reason_zh: 说明支持指定区域内反复生效的场地机制，但没有交代该机制是否需要A杖。

rows.quote: Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
rows.reason_zh: 说明支持灵光迫使敌人靠近，但没有交代该效果是否需要A杖。

rows.quote: hit_count.base: [7]→[8]
rows.reason_zh: 灵光承受的攻击次数由7次增至8次，仍属于召唤物定义排除的按受击次数计算的单位。

rows.quote: attacking enemies in an area
rows.reason_zh: 每次施放仍能攻击区域内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Doesn't apply Cleave.
rows.reason_zh: 说明仍明确排除分裂溅射。

rows.quote: echo_hero_damage: [20,40,60,80]→null
rows.reason_zh: 调整涉及斩击自身的伤害，未给目标施加提高所受伤害的效果。

rows.quote: applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow
rows.reason_zh: 斩击命中时仍会短暂降低敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: Destroys trees.
rows.reason_zh: 斩击仍能摧毁树木。

rows.quote: Kez has phased collision
rows.reason_zh: 天隼冲击期间，凯仍能无视单位碰撞。

rows.quote: rush towards enemy targets
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍能向敌方目标冲刺。

rows.quote: While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
rows.reason_zh: 凯在该状态下仍获得减速抗性。

rows.quote: While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
rows.reason_zh: 相位移动只说明单位碰撞规则，材料没有说明凯能穿树或越过悬崖。

rows.quote: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.
rows.reason_zh: 爪钩仍会带动凯移向目标单位或树木。

rows.quote: When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: 爪钩命中单位后仍会降低其移动速度。

rows.quote: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.
rows.reason_zh: 可以选树作为爪钩目标，但说明没有交代移动途中能否穿树或越过悬崖。

rows.quote: Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
rows.reason_zh: 爪钩可选择敌方单位为目标，凯抵达后会攻击该单位。

rows.quote: a series of deadly radial slashes around him
rows.reason_zh: 斩击仍能伤害凯周围的多个目标，作用半径缩至425。

rows.quote: receiving a basic dispel
rows.reason_zh: 施放时凯仍会对自身施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: with enhanced lifesteal
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍能通过斩击吸血恢复生命，但攻击小兵时不再获得回复。

rows.quote: becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s
rows.reason_zh: 施放过程中凯仍会短暂无敌。

rows.quote: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing an illusion. Slashes do not lifesteal from creeps.
rows.reason_zh: 基础斩击仍有吸血，攻击幻象时吸血降低，攻击小兵时不吸血。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 基础斩击的伤害类型字段由纯粹改为物理。

rows.quote: Kez receives a basic dispel
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍会对自身施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: briefly reducing their vision
rows.reason_zh: 烟雾短暂降低敌方视野，说明没有赋予敌方攻击落空概率。

rows.quote: gains bonus movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍会获得移动速度加成。

rows.quote: invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍会进入隐身，攻击或施法会打破隐身。

rows.quote: nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision
rows.reason_zh: 烟雾仍会短暂降低附近敌方英雄的视野。

rows.quote: When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.
rows.reason_zh: 凯普攻带标记的目标时仍会附带眩晕，符合攻击特效定义。

rows.quote: When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.
rows.reason_zh: 攻击带标记的目标仍能触发眩晕，符合重击定义。

rows.quote: Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.
rows.reason_zh: 凯使用双钗攻击时仍有概率暴击。

rows.quote: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶提高强化标记的暴击伤害，触发暴击的机制在基础技能中已有。

rows.quote: parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍可招架指定方向的攻击，挡下这些攻击的伤害。

rows.quote: disarm himself
rows.reason_zh: 主动招架时受到缴械的是凯自身，技能没有对敌方目标施加缴械。

rows.quote: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶强化标记已有的眩晕，施加眩晕本身无需魔晶。

rows.quote: that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark
rows.reason_zh: 成功招架敌方英雄的攻击仍会眩晕该英雄并施加标记。

rows.quote: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.
rows.reason_zh: 利爪飞掷的固定伤害攻击仍具有必中效果。

rows.quote: applying a fixed damage attack and silence
rows.reason_zh: 飞钗命中时仍会对目标施加沉默。

rows.quote: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
rows.reason_zh: 凯仍可选择单个敌方单位投掷飞钗。

rows.quote: damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage
rows.reason_zh: 幽灵船撞毁时仍会伤害落点附近的所有敌人。

rows.quote: from the port and starboard side, plus %forward_cannon_count% straight ahead, that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies
rows.reason_zh: A杖舰队的炮弹仍可贯穿多个敌人，7.42另增加了两枚向前发射的炮弹。

rows.quote: Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
rows.reason_zh: 幽灵船仍给接触到的友方英雄施加统帅朗姆酒，机制表明确将其延迟结算伤害的效果计入减伤。

rows.quote: stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage
rows.reason_zh: 幽灵船仍会眩晕撞毁位置附近的所有敌人。

rows.quote: cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike
rows.reason_zh: 一次攻击仍能伤害昆卡前方区域内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike
rows.reason_zh: 这一击获得伤害加成和分裂，按给定定义无需另记攻击特效。

rows.quote: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只描述强化攻击和分裂，材料未给出判定可被破坏所需的 IsBreakable 字段值。

rows.quote: cleaves a large area of effect in front of him
rows.reason_zh: 强化攻击仍会对昆卡前方区域造成分裂伤害。

rows.quote: for a single strike
rows.reason_zh: 说明描述的是强化昆卡的一次攻击，没有描述对敌方单位单独施放指向技能。

rows.quote: marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds
rows.reason_zh: 昆卡仍可把目标英雄送回标记位置。

rows.quote: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero
rows.reason_zh: 施法距离调整后，技能仍可选择单个敌方英雄为目标。

rows.quote: He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities
rows.reason_zh: 进入演奏状态时受到缴械的是朗戈自身，技能没有对敌方目标施加缴械。

rows.quote: Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.
rows.reason_zh: 伤害仅作用于被舔中的单个敌方目标。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍会对目标施加弱驱散。

rows.quote: pulling it back a short distance
rows.reason_zh: 朗戈仍会将目标单位拉回一小段距离。
击杀目标或驱散效果仍会给予朗戈临时生命恢复，各级回复数值均大于零。

rows.quote: Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.
rows.reason_zh: 施放时仍可直接选择单个敌方单位。

rows.quote: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
rows.reason_zh: 法术放大用于限定哪些伤害能触发回响，技能调整的是回响比例，没有赋予友军法术放大。

rows.quote: increases nearby friendly units' movement speed
rows.reason_zh: 歌曲仍会提高附近友方单位的移动速度。

rows.quote: grants a brief slow resistance
rows.reason_zh: 歌曲仍会给予附近友方单位短暂的减速抗性。

rows.quote: deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 歌曲仍能对附近多个敌人造成魔法伤害。

rows.quote: grants their attacks additional magic damage
rows.reason_zh: 附近友方英雄的普通攻击仍会附带额外魔法伤害。

rows.quote: increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification
rows.reason_zh: 歌曲提高友方英雄的法术放大，没有给敌人施加减魔抗或魔法易伤。

rows.quote: spell_amp_bonus.base: [8,12,16]→[6,8,10]
rows.reason_zh: 友方英雄获得的法术放大有所下调，各级加成仍大于零。

rows.quote: heals nearby friendly heroes
rows.reason_zh: 歌曲仍会治疗附近的友方英雄。

rows.quote: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
rows.reason_zh: A杖说明确认获胜时会自动触发强攻，但材料没有给出强攻的驱散类型。

rows.quote: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
rows.reason_zh: 被推开2000距离是结束决斗的条件，决斗自身没有推动目标。

rows.quote: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
rows.reason_zh: A杖说明只确认自动触发强攻，材料没有说明强攻是否恢复生命。

rows.quote: Neither hero can use items
rows.reason_zh: 决斗期间双方英雄仍无法使用物品。

rows.quote: the target enemy hero cannot use abilities
rows.reason_zh: 决斗仍会禁止目标敌方英雄施放技能。

rows.quote: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other
rows.reason_zh: 决斗仍迫使双方互相攻击，符合嘲讽定义。

rows.quote: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other
rows.reason_zh: 军团指挥官施放决斗时仍须选定一个敌方英雄。
